<ApiTitle method="get" title="Get Template Signature Setup" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/turbosign/templates/{templateId}/signature-setup"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Lists the signer roles saved on a PDF signature template, with the key to pass as a recipient's `role` when you send it. Each role shows whether a saved signer fills it when you leave it out.
